title: A Complete Proof of the Strong Conjecture about $F$-Irregular Graphs
summary: A graph $G$ is called $F$-irregular if all its vertices have distinct $F$-degrees, defined as the number of subgraphs of $G$ isomorphic to a given graph $F$ and containing the respective vertex. We prove the Strong Conjecture about $F$-irregular graphs (Dovzhenok, Filuta, and Chuhai, 2024), which states that for every connected graph $F$ of order at least three, there exist infinitely many $F$-irregular graphs.
